What it solves: `depends_on: [BL-1398]` names a ticket at the hardener on 2026-09-04, not
yet in `backlog/done/`. The BL-957 promotion gate fails closed until it
lands, so this ticket cannot be promoted early; that is the intended
sequencing. A second parser to avoid the dependency would be a DRY defect
the cleane…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Surfaced by the architect on BL-1398's review (2026-09-04): the acceptance-side twin of the fixture BL-1398 fixes, reproduced at 4 pass / 7 fail.
BL-1401 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1401" (or "reject BL-1401 <reason>") to act.
